Formats include in person, hybrid, evenings and weekdays (availability varies). Dallas College estimates tuition for the EMT Basic Certificate at $1,782 for in-county residents.

reason: The codified text on Cornell (last amended eff. 2/12/2017) says exactly this, with no separate clinical-hour minimum. However, DSHS has a pending rule revision. A search result summarizing a March 2026 GETAC presentation (the PDF now returns 404) described a proposal to raise the EMT minimum to 192 hours, including 48 clinical/field hours. A DSHS 'DRAFT' rules resource document dated 8-20-2026 exists, but I couldn't extract its §157.32 text. I couldn't confirm whether the change was adopted by 2026-11-22, so the present-tense claim may be out of date.
found: (B) The course shall include a minimum of 150 clock hours of classroom, laboratory, clinical, and field instruction which shall include supervised experiences in the emergency department and with a licensed EMS provider and in other settings as needed ... amended ... eff. 2/12/2017
suggested_fix: As codified (last amended 2017), 25 TAC 157.32 requires an EMT course to include at least 150 clock hours of classroom, laboratory, clinical and field instruction, including supervised emergency department and EMS experience, with no separate minimum for clinical hours. DSHS has drafted a revision in 2026 (reportedly 192 hours including 48 clinical/field hours); whether it has been adopted is unconfirmed.
